render.blue-blue:
global
    log stdout format raw local0
    master-worker

defaults
    log global
    mode http
    timeout connect 5s
    timeout client 1h
    timeout server 1h
    timeout tunnel 1h
    timeout http-request 10s

# API is private to loopback and the established tailnet address. cloudflared
# keeps targeting 127.0.0.1:8000, so this frontend preserves that contract.
frontend ft_api_loopback
    bind 127.0.0.1:8000
    default_backend bk_api

frontend ft_api_tailnet
    bind 100.122.100.56:8000
    default_backend bk_api

backend bk_api
    option httpchk GET /healthz
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 5s fall 2 rise 1
    server api_active 127.0.0.1:8001 check

# Do not add a wildcard/public bind: MCP is reachable only through the NCP
# loopback listener and its tailnet address.
frontend ft_mcp_loopback
    bind 127.0.0.1:8765
    default_backend bk_mcp

frontend ft_mcp_tailnet
    bind 100.122.100.56:8765
    default_backend bk_mcp

backend bk_mcp
    option httpchk GET /health
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 5s fall 2 rise 1
    server mcp_active 127.0.0.1:8766 check

# Fixed-profile MCP units bind loopback only inside their containers; the
# tailnet reaches them through these listeners so haproxy stays the single
# tailnet-facing process (same port numbers as the Mac launchd services).

frontend ft_mcp_analysis_readonly_tailnet
    bind 100.122.100.56:8768
    default_backend bk_mcp_analysis_readonly

backend bk_mcp_analysis_readonly
    option httpchk GET /health
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 5s fall 2 rise 1
    server mcp_analysis_readonly 127.0.0.1:8768 check

frontend ft_mcp_account_read_tailnet
    bind 100.122.100.56:8769
    default_backend bk_mcp_account_read

backend bk_mcp_account_read
    option httpchk GET /health
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 5s fall 2 rise 1
    server mcp_account_read 127.0.0.1:8769 check

frontend ft_mcp_tradingcodex_execution_tailnet
    bind 100.122.100.56:8770
    default_backend bk_mcp_tradingcodex_execution

backend bk_mcp_tradingcodex_execution
    option httpchk GET /health
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 5s fall 2 rise 1
    server mcp_tradingcodex_execution 127.0.0.1:8770 check

frontend ft_mcp_paper_001_tailnet
    bind 100.122.100.56:8771
    default_backend bk_mcp_paper_001

backend bk_mcp_paper_001
    option httpchk GET /health
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 5s fall 2 rise 1
    server mcp_paper_001 127.0.0.1:8771 check

frontend ft_mcp_kiwoom_tailnet
    bind 100.122.100.56:8772
    default_backend bk_mcp_kiwoom

backend bk_mcp_kiwoom
    option httpchk GET /health
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 5s fall 2 rise 1
    server mcp_kiwoom 127.0.0.1:8772 check

# Task 975 (operator Q-87 A): dedicated live-session MCP units, one per market,
# each serving its closed-world MCP_PROFILE from config/mcp_profiles/live.yaml.

frontend ft_mcp_live_kr_tailnet

backend bk_mcp_live_kr

    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 5s fall 2 rise 1
    server mcp_live_kr 127.0.0.1:8773 check

frontend ft_mcp_live_us_tailnet
    bind 100.122.100.56:8774
    default_backend bk_mcp_live_us

backend bk_mcp_live_us
    option httpchk GET /health
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 5s fall 2 rise 1
    server mcp_live_us 127.0.0.1:8774 check

frontend ft_mcp_live_crypto_tailnet
    bind 100.122.100.56:8775
    default_backend bk_mcp_live_crypto

backend bk_mcp_live_crypto
    option httpchk GET /health
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 5s fall 2 rise 1
    server mcp_live_crypto 127.0.0.1:8775 check

# #1189 (part C of #1171): the H3-CRYPTO paper pilot unit serving the
# closed-world MCP_PROFILE=h3-crypto-paper. Tailnet only, like the units above.

    bind 100.122.100.56:8776

backend bk_mcp_h3_crypto_paper
